_comment: P1 open-action-space preregistration. All scenarios reuse the same safe
RouterShim truth generator and the same model/report protocol. The fixture
runner is engineering validation; only completion-command provenance is model evidence.

scenarios.hypothesis: Fixed A1 needs many epochs to cover a broad task; composed A2 can diversify within each epoch.
Aliased prefixes coexist with sparse real regions; per-epoch cross-prefix composition should matter.
A tight budget makes spending on saturated regions especially damaging.
Some responsive regions contain real diversity while saturated regions carry one source.
